FORBIDDEN_PROFILE_UPDATE: You can only update your own profile.
PASSWORD_UPDATE_NOT_ALLOWED: Password updates are not supported on this endpoint.
TRIAL_EXPIRED: Your trial has expired. Please choose a plan to continue.
INVALID_TOKEN: The link is invalid or has expired.
TOKEN_EXPIRED: This link has expired. Please request a new one.
WEEKLY_REVIEW_ROLE_INELIGIBLE: Weekly review is unavailable for your current role.
WEEKLY_REVIEW_NOT_ENABLED: Enable both email notifications and weekly review email to preview.
WEEKLY_REVIEW_SEND_FAILED: Failed to send weekly review email.
operation_running: Another budget operation is running. Try again when it has finished.
APP_CRASH_BODY: The page could not be displayed. Reloading usually fixes it.
list_context_not_found: The saved filters of this list are no longer available. Set the filters again.
duplicate: This record already exists. Reload the page to see the current data.
parent_gone: Something this change depends on was deleted in the meantime. Reload the page to see the current data.
in_use: This change would remove something that is still used elsewhere, so it was not saved.
not_found: This item no longer exists. Reload the page to see the current list.
retry: Another change to the same data was saved at the same moment, so this one did not go through. Please try again.
busy: This data is busy with another operation. Please try again in a few seconds.
notSavedYet: Your last change is not saved yet because the server is busy. It stays on this page and is sent again with your next change.
edit_conflict: Someone else changed this field while you were editing it. Choose which value to keep.
edit_conflict_unreadable: Someone else changed what you were saving, and the answer could not be read. Your values stay on screen, not saved yet.
administrator_required: Only an administrator of this workspace can do this.
demo_status_conflict: The sample data status changed in the meantime. Reload the page to see where it stands.
demo_load_capacity: Other workspaces are loading sample data right now. Try again in a few minutes.
tenant_not_empty: Sample data can only be loaded into an empty workspace. This workspace already holds data.
host_mismatch: This request does not come from the address of this workspace. Open the workspace at its own address and try again.
demo_data_unavailable: Sample data is not available on the server right now. Try again in a few minutes.
tenant_resetting: This workspace is being erased and put back in its starting state. Try again in a moment.
tenant_reset_running: This workspace is already being erased. Try again when it has finished.
confirmation_mismatch: The name typed does not match the name of the workspace.
rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
SHARE_TOO_MANY_RECIPIENTS: A link can be sent to 20 recipients at most.
SHARE_RATE_LIMITED: You have sent the maximum of 30 links in the last hour. Try again later.
MARKDOWN_TOO_LARGE: This text is too long: the limit is 200 KB of text (images do not count).
MARKDOWN_TOO_LARGE_DOCUMENT: This document is over the 200 KB of text a save accepts (images do not count). Shorten it to save your changes. The last saved version is kept.
MARKDOWN_TOO_COMPLEX: This text is too complex to process. Put pasted logs or code in a code block, or close the formatting marks (* and _).
MARKDOWN_BUSY: The server is busy with other texts. Try again in a moment.
MARKDOWN_UNAVAILABLE: Formatted texts cannot be saved right now. Try again in a few minutes.
MARKDOWN_UNAVAILABLE_onprem: Formatted texts cannot be saved on this server right now. Ask your administrator to check the API logs.
CSV_ACCOUNT_COA_CODE_REQUIRED: Enter the chart of accounts code (coa_code).
CSV_ACCOUNT_NUMBER_REQUIRED: The account number (account_number) is required and must be a whole number.
CSV_ACCOUNT_NUMBER_TOO_LONG: {{value}} has more than {{max}} digits. Use at most {{max}} digits.
CSV_ACCOUNT_NUMBER_LEADING_ZEROS: {{value}} will be stored as {{stored}}: the leading zeros are dropped.
CSV_ACCOUNT_STATUS_INVALID: Invalid status "{{value}}". Use enabled or disabled.
CSV_ACCOUNT_CONSOLIDATION_NUMBER_INVALID: The consolidation account number (consolidation_account_number) must be a whole number.
CSV_ACCOUNT_NATURE_INVALID: Invalid nature "{{value}}". Use opex, capex or leave the cell empty.
CSV_ACCOUNT_COA_CODE_MIXED: Every row must name the same chart of accounts (coa_code).
CSV_ACCOUNT_COA_CODE_UNKNOWN: No chart of accounts has the code "{{code}}".
CSV_ACCOUNT_COA_REQUIRED: Choose a chart of accounts, or add a coa_code column.
CSV_ENCODING_UNSUPPORTED: This file is not UTF-8 or Windows-1252. Save it again as CSV UTF-8.
CSV_FILE_EXCEL: This file is an Excel workbook, not a CSV. In Excel: File › Save As › CSV UTF-8 (Comma delimited).
CSV_FILE_OPENDOCUMENT: This file is an OpenDocument spreadsheet, not a CSV. In LibreOffice Calc: File › Save As › Text CSV.
CSV_FILE_NOT_TEXT: This file is not a CSV file. Save it as CSV UTF-8 and import it again.
CSV_VALUE_ONE_REQUIRED: Fill in at least one {{column}} column.
CSV_DATE_INVALID: "{{value}}" is not a date. Use 2026-09-02 or 02/09/2026.
CSV_BOOLEAN_INVALID: "{{value}}" is not valid. Use true or false, yes or no, 1 or 0.
CSV_ENUM_INVALID: "{{value}}" is not valid. Use one of: {{allowed}}.
CSV_REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND_SKIPPED: "{{value}}" was not found and is not imported.
CSV_REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND_CLEARED: "{{value}}" was not found: the field stays empty.
CSV_JSON_INVALID: This cell is not valid JSON.
CSV_JSON_OBJECT_REQUIRED: This cell must hold a JSON object.
CSV_JSON_ARRAY_REQUIRED: This cell must hold a JSON list.
CSV_SUPPLIER_NAME_DUPLICATE: "{{name}}" is already on row {{firstRow}}. Keep one row per supplier.
CSV_CONTACT_NOT_FOUND: Contact not found: {{email}}. Create it in Contacts first.
CSV_EMAIL_INVALID: "{{value}}" is not a valid e-mail address.
CSV_STATUS_DATE_PASSED: The status is enabled but the end of validity has passed. Clear the date or set the status to disabled. If the file comes from an older export, export the data again.
CSV_STATUS_DATE_FUTURE: The status is disabled but the end of validity is still to come. Set the status to enabled or enter a date that has passed.
SUPPLIER_IN_USE: This supplier is used by {{usages}}. Disable it instead of deleting it.
COMPANY_IN_USE: This company is used by {{usages}}. Disable it instead of deleting it.
CONTRACT_HAS_COMPLIANCE_RECORDS: This contract has {{usages}}. Disable it instead of deleting it.
ASSET_IN_USE_one: This asset is used by {{usages}}. Remove it from there before deleting it.
ASSET_IN_USE_other: This asset is used by {{usages}}. Remove it from them before deleting it.
APPLICATION_HAS_INTERFACES_one: This application is the source or target of {{usages}}. Disable it instead, or delete that interface first.
APPLICATION_HAS_INTERFACES_other: This application is the source or target of {{usages}}. Disable it instead, or delete those interfaces first.
COST_CENTER_IN_USE: This cost center is used by {{usages}}. Disable it instead of deleting it.
COST_CENTER_HAS_NODES_one: This group contains {{usages}}. Move or delete it first.
COST_CENTER_HAS_NODES_other: This group contains {{usages}}. Move or delete them first.
CALENDAR_IN_USE: This calendar is used by {{usages}}. Disable it instead of deleting it.
USER_OWN_ACCOUNT: You cannot delete your own account. Disable it instead if needed.
ACCOUNT_IN_USE: This account is used by {{usages}}. Disable it instead of deleting it.
CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS_IN_USE_one: This chart of accounts is used by {{usages}}. Move it to another chart of accounts first.
CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS_IN_USE_other: This chart of accounts is used by {{usages}}. Move them to another chart of accounts first.
RECORD_IN_USE: Other records still use this item. Disable it instead of deleting it.
CATALOG_VALUE_IN_USE: "{{value}}" is still used by {{usages}}. Mark it as no longer offered instead of removing it.
ANALYTICS_VALUE_IN_USE: This value is used by {{usages}}. Disable it, or delete it anyway from its page: the lines lose it.
ANALYTICS_DIMENSION_HAS_VALUES_one: This dimension still has {{usages}}. Delete it first, or delete the dimension from its page with its value.
ANALYTICS_DIMENSION_HAS_VALUES_other: This dimension still has {{usages}}. Delete them first, or delete the dimension from its page with its values.
ANALYTICS_DEFAULT_DIMENSION: This dimension cannot be deleted: older files and AI questions use it. Disable its values instead.
BUDGET_LINE_FROZEN: This line has amounts in {{column}} {{year}}, a frozen budget column. Unfreeze the column first, or set an end of validity date instead of deleting the line.
DEPARTMENT_IN_USE: This department is used in the allocations of {{usages}}. Disable it instead of deleting it.
BUILT_IN_RECORD: This item comes with KANAP and cannot be deleted. Disable it instead.
RECORD_USED_BY: This item is used by {{usages}}. Disable it instead of deleting it.
TEAM_NOT_EMPTY_one: This team still has {{usages}}. Move it to another team first, or disable the team.
TEAM_NOT_EMPTY_other: This team still has {{usages}}. Move them to another team first, or disable the team.
ROLE_BUILT_IN: This role comes with KANAP and cannot be deleted. Duplicate it to make a role you can change.
ROLE_IN_USE_one: This role is given to {{usages}}. Give them another role first.
ROLE_IN_USE_other: This role is given to {{usages}}. Give them another role first.
APP_INSTANCE_IN_USE_one: This instance still has {{usages}}. Remove it first.
APP_INSTANCE_IN_USE_other: This instance still has {{usages}}. Remove them first.
INTERFACE_HAS_BINDINGS_one: This interface has {{usages}}. Delete its binding with it, or remove it first.
INTERFACE_HAS_BINDINGS_other: This interface has {{usages}}. Delete its bindings with it, or remove them first.
MAPPING_SET_DEFAULT: The default mapping set cannot be deleted. Make another set the default first.
MAPPING_GROUP_DEFAULT: Default mapping groups cannot be deleted. Leave the group empty if you do not need it.
REQUEST_CONVERTED: This request became a project and stays as its origin. It cannot be deleted.
TASK_REQUEST_ORIGIN: Request {{reference}} was created from this task. Close the task instead of deleting it.
KNOWLEDGE_DOCUMENT_MANAGED: This document belongs to a record's page and is deleted with that record. It cannot be deleted from Knowledge.
KNOWLEDGE_LIBRARY_SYSTEM: This library comes with KANAP and cannot be deleted.
KNOWLEDGE_LIBRARY_LAST: This is the last library you can use. Create another library before deleting it.
KNOWLEDGE_FOLDER_HAS_SUBFOLDERS_one: This folder still has {{usages}}. Move or delete it first.
KNOWLEDGE_FOLDER_HAS_SUBFOLDERS_other: This folder still has {{usages}}. Move or delete them first.
